description.en: Marginal tax rate for the fourth band of the progressive income tax schedule, currently 30% (0.30), applied to taxable income between $tin_upthres3 and $tin_upthres4 (roughly 29 315 to 83 822 EUR in 2025, Table 2.77). It is used as the Band_Rate parameter in the tin_fr SchedCalc computing gross income tax and in tinkt_fr's Imax recalculation of gross tax with the adjusted family quotient.

explanation.en: EUROMOD function group: Paramteres of the income tax
